## New
- **Light or dark:** Settings → General has a switch for light and dark, and it works with both themes. The big player stays a dark stage in the colours of the cover
- **Faster start page:** the start page is kept in memory once it has loaded, so coming back to it is instant until you close the app. Suggestions that take longer no longer hold the page back, they appear when they are ready

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** uninstall Musik once, then install the new `Musik.apk`
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
